uzo.purpose: Switches between views of the same thing on one page: content, versions, rules, audit.

instead.kialo: A choice in a form is a value, not a switch of views, because it is sent with the form and read back as data; that is the elekto.
Pages of an application are a navigation, because the person leaves where they are; tabs switch views of one thing and stay on the page.
Content that is hidden until opened is a disclosure, because tabs always show one view; the faldilo opens and closes, several in a group one at a time.
The pages of one long list are a pagination, because the person moves through parts of the same list in order; tabs switch views of one thing.

boundary.kialo: A tab a person can close is a document, not a view of one thing, because closing it removes content; Fundamento has no such tab.
Selection follows the focus here (automatic activation), because a panel that is cheap to show should show at once; a panel that is slow to load wants Enter to select, which a person decides.
Tabs along the side read like a navigation, because a column of places is what a sidebar is; a person decides whether these are views of one thing or pages.

containers.name: page-section
containers.kialo: Tabs head a section of the page, because the views they switch belong to that section's one thing.

case.de: Die Person wechselt zu einer anderen Seite der Anwendung.
case.en: The person moves to another page of the application.

case.de: Die Wahl ist ein Wert, der mit einem Formular gesendet wird.
case.en: The choice is a value that is sent with a form.

case.de: Inhalt soll verborgen sein, bis jemand ihn öffnet.
case.en: Content is to stay hidden until someone opens it.

case.de: Es geht um die Seiten einer einzigen langen Liste.
case.en: It is about the pages of one long list.

do.de: Benenne jeden Reiter mit einem eigenen, kurzen Wort für seine Ansicht.
do.en: Name every tab with a short word of its own for its view.

do.de: Gib der Reiterleiste mit label einen Namen, den der Screenreader hört.
do.en: Give the tab bar a name with label that the screen reader hears.

do.de: Nimm spread fill, wenn wenige Reiter die ganze Breite teilen sollen.
do.en: Use spread fill when a few tabs should share the whole width.

dont.de: Reiter zum Schließen anbieten, denn ein Reiter ist eine Ansicht, kein Dokument.
dont.en: Offer tabs that can be closed, because a tab is a view, not a document.

dont.de: Reiter senkrecht als Seitenleiste stapeln, denn das liest sich wie eine Navigation.
dont.en: Stack tabs upright as a side bar, because that reads like a navigation.

action.de: Wählt den vorigen oder nächsten Reiter und zeigt seine Ansicht, deaktivierte werden übersprungen, am Ende geht es von vorn weiter.
action.en: Selects the previous or next tab and shows its view, skipping disabled ones and wrapping at the end.

action.de: Wählt den ersten oder letzten Reiter.
action.en: Selects the first or last tab.
